comparison.objective: Join and positively retain two drive-chain ends using a connecting link, cover plate and spring clips; candidate separates mixed finishing media and washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Sub-millimetre coaxial pin/bore alignment, plate placement and spring-clip capture using an applicator versus bimanual load-bearing screen manipulation, controlled tilt/agitation, particle passage and selective retention.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both pins and bushings seated, cover bores aligned, two clips closed in grooves, chain returned to its guide/cradle, applicator withdrawn, robot clear and a 1 s stable hold. Candidate requires target-media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, screen reseated on both supports, hands clear and a 3 s hold.
comparison.reason: Chain assembly tests close-tolerance insertion and positive retention; the candidate tests dynamic many-body classification by aperture size. Generic alignment, bimanual coordination and final release do not establish overlap.
